summary: End-to-end validation of Partners (dealer groups), Inventory Sources (csv_upload/http_feed/scraper), Referrals, and Cron sync for AutoNova AI. 11/11 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend flows for Partners (create/expand/add source/edit/delete + default protected) and Referrals (status change + Mon Coequipier ref save) verified via Playwright on the public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1322 lines — getting large; dealer-groups/inventory-sources/referrals/cron routers could be split into dedicated modules for maintainability.
DealerGroup slug is derived from name without uniqueness check — two groups with same name produce duplicate slugs (not currently used as a lookup key, so low-risk, but worth noting).
update_dealer_group accepts raw dict body (no Pydantic model) — permits unexpected fields to be written to DB; consider a DealerGroupUpdate model.
run_source for scraper/api returns 200 with skipped_reason — fine, but the frontend may want to surface the 'framework ready' message more clearly (currently 'last_status' becomes 'idle').
_feed_urls falls back to relative URL when PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var is unset; in this environment PUBLIC_BASE_URL is set so OK, but a missing env would produce non-copyable URLs.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* dealer groups and sources but clean them up (delete non-default group). CSV push test adds 2 vehicles (TESTSTK1/2) which get deactivated via mode=full within the same test.
verified_behaviours: Default 'House Inventory' dealer group exists, is_default=true, delete returns 400.
POST /api/dealer-groups creates group with name/website/referral_amount/referral_program; PATCH persists changes.
csv_upload source returns {push_url, full_push_url} (feed_token NOT leaked); URL contains token= and mode=full.
http_feed /inventory-sources/{id}/run against public /api/inventory/template imports >=1 row and last_status becomes 'success'.
scraper source /run returns 200 with stub (no error); last_status becomes 'idle'.
Pushing CSV to csv_upload push_url imports into the specific dealer_group_id; mode=full deactivates missing vehicles.
POST /api/cron/sync-sources returns 401 without/with wrong Bearer; returns 200 {'accepted': true} with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET.
GET /api/referrals returns {referrals, totals: {pipeline, earned, count}, statuses}.
POST /leads/{id}/run-inventory-match auto-creates a referral; PATCH /referrals/{id} updates status + external_reference.
Frontend: Partners page loads, cards render, create/expand/add-source/edit/delete + default group has no delete button.
Frontend: Referrals page shows stat cards (Pipeline value, Commission earned (paid), Total referrals) and table; status dropdown and Mon Coequipier ref save work (toast 'Marked sent' observed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_partners_inventory_referrals.py is pytest-compatible and reusable. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_partners_inventory_referrals.py -v -n0. AI teaser in public seller chat was not directly tested (depends on Gemini quota) — supporting backend path (run-inventory-match -> referral auto-create) is covered. All features in the Phase 1 Partners/Inventory/Referrals requirement work end-to-end.
